underlines.text: is outwardly distinguished by her try-works
removed from the top of the works

reference.text: Removing the fire-board from the front of the try-works, the bare masonry of that side is exposed, penetrated by the two iron mouths of the furnaces, directly underneath the pots.
Off hatch, then, and start her.

underlines.text: then made ghastly by flashes of redness

reference.text: Wrapped, for that interval, in darkness myself, I but the better saw the redness, the madness, the ghastliness of others.

underlines.text: when its redness makes all things look ghastly

reference.text: Nothing seemed before me but a jet gloom, now and then made ghastly by flashes of redness.

underlines.text: Give not thyself up, then, to fire

reference.text: Look not too long in the face of the fire, O man!
